#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <cstdlib>
using namespace std;

class TaskB {
public:
    void solve(int n, int m) {
        if (n > m) {
            swap(n, m);
        }
        long long V = (long long)n * m;

        if (V < 100) {
            int v = (int)V;
            vector<vector<int>> g(v);
            for (int i = 0; i < v; i++) {
                int r1 = i / m;
                int c1 = i % m;
                if ((r1 + c1) % 2 == 0) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < v; j++) {
                        int r2 = j / m;
                        int c2 = j % m;
                        if (abs(r1 - r2) + abs(c1 - c2) == 3) {
                            g[i].push_back(j);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            int pairs = maxMatching(g, m);
            cout << pairs * 2 << endl;
        } else {
            long long res;
            if (n == 1) {
                res = m / 6 * 6;
                if (m % 6 == 4) res += 2;
                if (m % 6 == 5) res += 4;
            } else {
                res = V;
                res -= res % 2;
            }
            cout << res << endl;
        }
    }

private:
    static int maxMatching(vector<vector<int>>& g, int cols) {
        int v = g.size();
        vector<int> matchR(v, -1);
        int pairs = 0;
        for (int u = 0; u < v; u++) {
            int r = u / cols;
            int c = u % cols;
            if ((r + c) % 2 == 0) {
                vector<bool> seen(v, false);
                if (dfs(u, g, matchR, seen)) {
                    pairs++;
                }
            }
        }
        return pairs;
    }

    static bool dfs(int u, vector<vector<int>>& g, vector<int>& matchR, vector<bool>& seen) {
        for (int v : g[u]) {
            if (seen[v]) continue;
            seen[v] = true;
            if (matchR[v] == -1 || dfs(matchR[v], g, matchR, seen)) {
                matchR[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
};

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(NULL);
    int n, m;
    cin >> n >> m;
    TaskB solver;
    solver.solve(n, m);
    return 0;
}
